results.title: Mahindra BE 6 Sporteq Edition Launched at Rs 11.45 Lakh, Gets Triple-Screen Cabin, Google Gemini and Drift Mode
results.description: Mahindra BE 6 Sporteq launches at Rs 11.45 lakh (ex-showroom) with Battery-as-a-Service, featuring a triple-screen cabin, Google Gemini, Drift Mode, connected technology and upgraded equipment.
